column1: # EU AI Act system questionnaire - fill `value` (yes/no for questions; blank = unanswered and reported as an open question). `notes` holds the question and article.

column4: notes
Name of the AI system
Your role for this system: provider | deployer | importer | distributor [Art. 3(3)-(7)]
Intended purpose in one sentence [Art. 3(12)]
Date first placed on the market / put into service (YYYY-MM-DD) [Art. 111, Art. 50(2) transition]
Named owner for the obligations (role or person)
Uses subliminal, manipulative or deceptive techniques that materially distort behaviour causing significant harm? [Art. 5(1)(a)]
Exploits vulnerabilities due to age, disability or social/economic situation causing significant harm? [Art. 5(1)(b)]
Evaluates or classifies people by social behaviour or personality leading to detrimental or unjustified treatment (social scoring)? [Art. 5(1)(c)]
Predicts a person's risk of committing a crime based solely on profiling or personality traits? [Art. 5(1)(d)]
Builds or expands facial recognition databases by untargeted scraping of images from the internet or CCTV? [Art. 5(1)(e)]
Infers emotions of people in the workplace or in education (outside medical or safety reasons)? [Art. 5(1)(f)]
Categorises people by biometric data to infer race, political opinions, union membership, religion, sex life or orientation? [Art. 5(1)(g)]
Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces for law enforcement (outside the Art. 5(1)(h) exceptions)? [Art. 5(1)(h)]
Generates or manipulates realistic intimate or sexually explicit depictions of an identifiable person without consent? [Art. 5(1)(ba) (added by Reg. 2026/1744)]
Generates or manipulates child sexual abuse material? [Art. 5(1)(bb) (added by Reg. 2026/1744)]
Is it a safety component of (or itself) a product under Annex I harmonisation law that needs third-party conformity assessment? [Art. 6(1), Annex I]
Remote biometric identification, biometric categorisation or emotion recognition (where permitted)? [Annex III point 1]
Safety component in management/operation of critical digital infrastructure, road traffic, water, gas, heating or electricity? [Annex III point 2]
Education/vocational training: admission, evaluating learning outcomes, assessing education level, or proctoring? [Annex III point 3]
Employment: recruitment/selection, or decisions on promotion, termination, task allocation or monitoring of workers? [Annex III point 4]
Essential services: public benefits eligibility, creditworthiness/credit scoring, life/health insurance pricing, or emergency call triage? [Annex III point 5]
Law enforcement uses listed in Annex III point 6? [Annex III point 6]
Migration, asylum or border control uses listed in Annex III point 7? [Annex III point 7]
Administration of justice or influencing elections/referendums or voting behaviour? [Annex III point 8]
Annex III only: intended to perform a narrow procedural task? [Art. 6(3)(a)]
Annex III only: intended to improve the result of a previously completed human activity? [Art. 6(3)(b)]
Annex III only: detects decision patterns or deviations, without replacing or influencing the human assessment absent proper human review? [Art. 6(3)(c)]
Annex III only: performs a preparatory task to an assessment relevant to an Annex III use case? [Art. 6(3)(d)]
Annex III only: performs profiling of natural persons? (if yes, always high-risk) [Art. 6(3) last subparagraph]
Intended to interact directly with natural persons? [Art. 50(1)]
Generates synthetic audio, image, video or text content? [Art. 50(2)]
Is an emotion recognition system (permitted use)? [Art. 50(3)]
Is a biometric categorisation system (permitted use)? [Art. 50(3)]
Generates or manipulates image, audio or video that constitutes a deep fake? [Art. 50(4)]
Generates or manipulates text published to inform the public on matters of public interest? [Art. 50(4)]

Deployers only: are you a body governed by public law or a private entity providing public services, or is the system used for Annex III point 5(b) creditworthiness/credit scoring or 5(c) life/health insurance pricing? [Art. 27(1)]
Are you the provider of a general-purpose AI model (not just a user of one)? [Art. 3(63), Art. 53]
Is that GPAI model classified as having systemic risk? [Art. 51, Art. 55]
